decisions.reason: Building directly on established shuttering and de-shuttering automation knowledge, the firm can assimilate early feedback and improve the robot, so withdrawal is unlikely.
The profile storage robot leverages existing in-house engineering and production-control capabilities, giving the firm strong absorptive capacity to interpret results and refine the product.
The automatic shuttering robot draws on core robotics and formwork competencies, and in-house R&D enables learning from early results rather than dropping the product.

Although newly launched as a product line, the combined magazining, cleaning, and plotting machine builds on established production equipment knowledge, so the firm can absorb market feedback and develop improvements.

The production analysis software is close to the firm's existing software and control offerings, but its more digital nature means somewhat less related physical-equipment knowledge, so withdrawal risk is slightly higher though still low.
